name: Tikka T3x CTR .308 Win, 16 inch

note.text: The reticle's line, dot, and hash sizes are Vortex's published figures. The positions of the hashes and wind dots are drawn from Vortex's subtension diagram, which Vortex marks "for representation only".

twistSources.label: 1:11 inch, 2014 Tikka T3 CTR specification sheet (20 inch barrel)
1:10 inch, current Tikka T3x CTR page (20 and 24 inch barrels)

twistNote: Tikka's own figures disagree and neither lists a 16 inch barrel, so this twist is unconfirmed. To measure it: push a tight patch on a cleaning rod into the bore, mark the rod at the muzzle and put a tape flag on the handle, push until the flag has made one full turn, and measure how far the mark moved. That distance in inches is your twist.
genericTwistNote: To measure your twist: push a tight patch on a cleaning rod into the bore, mark the rod at the muzzle and put a tape flag on the handle, push until the flag has made one full turn, and measure how far the mark moved. That distance in inches is your twist.
sightHeightNote: 1.75 inches is a typical scope height, not a measurement. Measure from the centre of the bolt to the centre of the scope tube.
